abstract: Since its first description in the early part of the twentieth century, struma ovarii has elicited considerable interest because of its many unique features; however, at present a number of aspects remain enigmatic. Although the typical presentation is that of a pelvic mass, unusual clinical manifestations such as hyperthyroidism, ascites, and Meigs' syndrome have been recognised. Uncommon macroscopic and especially histological patterns in struma can cause difficulties in diagnosis. Cystic strumas are challenging to diagnose both macroscopically and histologically. Proliferative changes within struma can be misdiagnosed as cancer. In regard to the occurrence of thyroid-type carcinoma in struma ovarii, precise terminology should be utilised, and the term 'malignant struma ovarii' should be avoided because it has been used for several different pathological entities. Papillary carcinoma is the most commonly occurring thyroid-type carcinoma in ovarian struma; however, cases of follicular carcinoma are not infrequent. Histological malignancy in struma does not necessarily equate with biological malignancy, and the majority of thyroid-type carcinomas do not spread beyond the ovary. Strumal carcinoid, a neoplasm apparently unique to the ovary containing elements of both struma and carcinoid, has been misdiagnosed as 'malignant struma ovarii' in the past. The differential diagnosis of extra-ovarian spread of struma includes the usual types of thyroid cancer, minimal deviation follicular carcinoma, and peritoneal strumosis. This review emphasises articles both recent and past that have significantly advanced our knowledge of struma ovarii and related neoplasms.

卵巣甲状腺腫の謎。

初めて記載されて以来、卵巣甲状腺腫は多くの独特な特徴から強い関心を集めてきたが、現在でも未解明な点が残されている。典型的な表現は骨盤内腫瘤であるが、甲状腺機能亢進症、腹水、Meigs症候群などの非典型的な臨床像も認識されている。甲状腺腫の特異な肉眼的・組織学的パターンは診断に困難をもたらす。嚢胞性甲状腺腫は肉眼的にも組織学的にも診断が難しい。甲状腺腫内の増殖性変化が癌と誤診されることがある。卵巣甲状腺腫に生じる甲状腺型癌に関しては、正確な用語を用いるべきであり、「悪性卵巣甲状腺腫」という用語は複数の異なる病理学的実体に用いられてきたため避けるべきである。甲状腺型癌のうち、乳頭癌が卵巣甲状腺腫で最も多く見られるが、濾胞癌も少なくない。甲状腺腫の組織学的悪性度が必ずしも生物学的悪性度を意味するわけではなく、甲状腺型癌の大部分は卵巣を越えて広がらない。卵巣に特有の腫瘍である甲状腺様カルチノイド（strumal carcinoid）は、甲状腺腫とカルチノイドの両要素を含み、過去には「悪性卵巣甲状腺腫」と誤診されてきた。甲状腺腫の卵巣外進展の鑑別診断には、通常の甲状腺癌の各型、ミニマルデビエーション型濾胞癌、腹膜甲状腺腫症が含まれる。本総説は、卵巣甲状腺腫および関連腫瘍の理解を大きく前進させた最近および過去の論文を重点的に取り上げる。
